name: Hushai (the Arkite)
title: David's faithful friend and advisor
summary: Hushai was an Arkite and a close friend and advisor to David. He played a crucial role during Absalom's rebellion by pretending to support Absalom, while in reality working to undermine Ahithophel's counsel and save David.

keyEvents.title: Meeting David on the Mount of Olives
keyEvents.description: When David fled from Jerusalem during Absalom's rebellion, Hushai met him on the Mount of Olives with torn clothes and dust on his head as a sign of mourning.

keyEvents.title: Sent back as a spy
keyEvents.description: David asked Hushai to return to Jerusalem and pretend to be loyal to Absalom, in order to counter Ahithophel's advice and send information to David.

keyEvents.title: Wins Absalom's trust
keyEvents.description: Hushai introduced himself to Absalom and convinced him of his loyalty by declaring 'Long live the king!' Absalom accepted him as an advisor.

keyEvents.title: Overcomes Ahithophel's counsel
keyEvents.description: Ahithophel advised pursuing David immediately, but Hushai argued persuasively for a different strategy that gave David time to escape. Absalom followed Hushai's advice.

keyEvents.title: Sends warning to David
keyEvents.description: After his advice was accepted, Hushai sent a message through the priests Zadok and Abiathar and their sons to David, so that he could cross the Jordan safely.
